changed: The pydantic-ai driver renders DriverInput.context (target 7.4, ADR 0032): stable prefix as instructions; dynamic suffix sent per request and never written to history or snapshot (streaming included); every observation as tool_return_text from RenderedObservation, no fallback to Observation.data; blocked-write and failed-read returns carry ids and statuses only; clearing keeps call/return pairs including parallel calls and is skipped while a write is pending; rendering: "pack" in the snapshot of a pack-rendered run only (D8). Unchanged when context is None (off and prompt goldens byte-identical). The ERP scripted driver reads facts from a pack. New on_model_request.json golden with its recorder. make e2e passed (150, 4 skipped) per the implementer. Commit 03516a6; review harness/state/3/reviews/3d.4.json (accept).
open_items: 3d.5 (plan): refuse a pinned-on call on a stricter route than an earlier turn (D3-41); apply the cleared stub when an action_result is present (D3-40, driver.py joins 3d.5); type the missing-rendering refusal and map it to CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE (D3-42); keep action_result ids-only (D3-43).
The on golden is built with the kernel's assemble; re-record it whenever kernel/context.py rendering changes (D3-44).
Narrow the scripted driver's pack-mode exception mapping (D3-45).
